sentence: The dome most visitors assume is a pure Michelangelo design is, on the building's own records, a collaboration finished by two other architects making their own calls, comparable to [the additional reinforcing used during Fallingwater's construction despite Wright's objections](/frank-lloyd-wright/).
note: Target records extra reinforcing during construction and Wright objections; analogy concerns later builders revising a design, not identical structural cause. Actual target quote: additional steel went into the beam

sentence: The most quoted line about the building's most photographed bronze object may be describing the wrong metal, much the same kind of afterlife a theft gave [the Mona Lisa's fame](/mona-lisa/), where the popular story and the documented one don't quite match.
note: Target documents a pre-existing reputation amplified by theft; comparison limited to discrepancy between popular story and historical record, not bronze provenance. Actual target quote: It fed an already well-regarded image

sentence: [Barcelona's Sagrada Família](/sagrada-familia/) inverts that same problem: a project begun in 1882 whose later builders have worked from Gaudí's surviving models and reconstructed plans.
note: Target records reconstruction from surviving models after fire; revised bridge distinguishes that reconstruction from StPeter multiple revisions. Actual target quote: survived a 1936 fire
